definition: Two or more events that happen together or one after the other, such as rolling two dice or picking two counters.
A table that shows every possible outcome of two combined events, with one event along the top and the other down the side.
A diagram with a column of branches for each stage. Each outcome is written at the end of its branch and its probability beside the branch; multiply along a path to find its probability.
Picking an item and putting it back before the next pick, so each pick has the same probabilities.
Picking an item and not putting it back, so there is one item fewer and the probabilities change for the next pick.
